description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score (y-axis) and Average Lagging (AL, x-axis) for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and a fourth method represented by a red line with star markers (likely a baseline or variant, though its label is obscured by a gray box in the legend). The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 1 to 8 with integer tick marks, indicating discrete or averaged lag values. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 20 to 30 with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The red line with star markers starts at approximately BLEU 25 at AL=1 and rises steadily to about BLEU 30 at AL=8. The purple dashed line with circle markers (Consistency-CE) begins at BLEU 20 at AL=1 and increases to roughly BLEU 29.5 at AL=8. The dark purple dashed line with square markers (Inconsistency-CE) starts near BLEU 22 at AL=1 and climbs to about BLEU 29.8 at AL=8. The blue dashed line with square markers (Inconsistency-CE-MP) begins at BLEU 22 at AL=1 and rises to approximately BLEU 29.5 at AL=8. All lines show a generally increasing trend in BLEU score as Average Lagging increases, with the red line consistently outperforming the others across the range.
